name: qfd_vm_rr4_w2-r44-5078addc9
purpose: Qwen TP8 VM row-read 4:1 rung (2 per region, 16 per die): 16 FSW-32 slices, select replicas + one AND-OR level over four banks' bx into t1, own row tag chain; 603 flops, one root; 2,048 bx pins on the W face, beside the four bx relays of its unit column (was rowrd_t: 4,096 pins, no legal place). Bench = region-leaf miter + the two rr4 mutants. Third cut: kept AND-OR tree at the first outline (first cut: star mapping, GRT-0116; the 51.84-um second cut blocked the whole relay strip and broke the lane plan).
